title: QA runs into launch week
detect_signals: No free week between the last build work and launch
sim_effect: Any slip in post-production or embedding pushes QA past launch; the course opens unfinished.
accepted_fixes: Pull embed and QA a week earlier so QA ends the week before launch
Plan QA to finish a week before launch and keep launch week for the hand-off only
partial_fixes: Ask for a director waiver to launch with QA still open
concept: Buffer: protect the launch date with slack on the critical path
sop_ref: PM SOP: Delivery phase; QA and migration finish before the course opens
explanation: With QA in launch week, any slip of a week misses the first day of term. A week of buffer before launch absorbs the slips every project has.
note: Planted on the three original projects; the plants name tasks the newer projects do not have.
